description: Source code for the 'comment' field type plugin in Drupal, defining the CommentItem class with its settings, schema, and methods.

classes.name: CommentItem
classes.description: Defines the comment field type plugin with settings, schema, and behavior for comments in Drupal.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings for the comment field, including comment type.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default field settings such as threading mode, comments per page, anonymous options, form location, and preview mode.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines data properties for comment status, last comment ID, timestamp, name, user ID, and comment count.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Provides the database schema for the comment field, including the 'status' column.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for editing field settings like threading, comments per page, anonymous commenting, form location, and preview mode.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates that the field is never empty; always has a value.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for selecting comment type, filtered by entity type.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample value for the comment status property.
